method: film-clustered nonparametric bootstrap over the 19 films; intensity is the length-normalised cue share under the executed rule (gate = dedicated Wikidata entity, recurrence >= 2 cues in the film); the top-5 set is compared for exact equality; Kendall tau-b is computed against the full-sample ordering of the gated concept pool
note: Values recomputed with the final length-normalised intensity definition. They supersede those reported in earlier drafts, where the ranking was computed from a replay whose pair accounting has since been corrected.
